message.content: In the conversation, LiHua expresses her admiration for Gerard Piqué, describing him as having "that combination of skill and intelligence in defense." She notes that Piqué deserves mention alongside Carles Puyol, another notable defender in FC Barcelona's history. LiHua emphasizes Piqué's ability to read the game, stating it was "incredible," and also mentions that he scored some crucial goals for the team. This indicates that LiHua views Piqué as a player who contributed significantly not only defensively but also offensively, praising his overall impact on the team.
